append.text: **Ps 67 *a fácie* seven times → *à face de* (67:3 twice, fire and God; 5b; 9 twice), 67:2 *fujam da sua face*** — *diante da face de* put 67:3b seven syllables over; the fire/God echo kept. Passed the Latinist twice; no reader remarked.
Ps 67:4, 5b *exsúltent in conspéctu Dei* → *exultem na presença de Deus* (joy, not being watched); 67:8 *egrederéris in conspéctu pópuli tui* → *saíeis à vista do vosso povo*. No remark.

**Ps 67:9, 17b, 19b → *pois*** — draft 1 *pois também* (καὶ γάρ) was heard as translationese by the stylist; draft 2 *pois até* (9, 19b) was refused by the gate ('even' added). The row's bare *pois* ends it.
Ps 67:2 *dissipéntur inimíci* → *sejam dispersos*; 67:31b *Díssipa gentes* → *Dispersai as nações* — the people proposal applied; no remark.

**Ps 67:15, 16b *mons pinguis* → *monte farto*** — *monte gordo* (draft 1) heard as comic by the stylist and the ambiguity reader; *farto* keeps a body-image of plenty. Row unchanged for animals and men; *gordo*, *fértil* (MS1932), *pingue* options.
Ps 67:16b *mons coagulátus … montes coagulátos* → *monte coalhado … montes coalhados* (τετυρωμένον); the ambiguity reader listed *coalhado* unknown in this sense; kept.

Ps 67:16b *ut quid suspicámini montes coagulátos?* → *por que suspeitais de montes coalhados?* — the object reading (MS1932); the bare object (draft 1, meant to keep DRB's vocative) sounded broken to the stylist and the vocative was inaudible. *recear* is 118:39's context.

**Ps 67:18 *Currus Dei decem míllibus múltiplex* → *O carro de Deus, multiplicado dez mil vezes*** — beside God and Sinai the ambiguity reader heard 'chariot' (the car sense noted as too modern); *carro de guerra* option.
Ps 67:18 *in Sina in sancto*, 67:25 *qui est in sancto* → *no lugar santo* (beside a place name / after *está*); no remark.

**Ps 67:19a *cepísti captivitátem* → *levastes cativo o cativeiro*** (Eph 4:8's form). The gate called it imported and asked *tomastes o cativeiro*; held — the Pauline reading is the verse's tradition, *tomastes o cativeiro* is opaque aloud; option.
**Ps 67:28a *in mentis excéssu* (Benjamin) → *em êxtase*** — *fora de si* (draft 1) was heard as fury or madness by all three v1 readers. *fora de mim* stays for 30:23's panic.
Ps 67:22 *vérticem capílli* → *o alto da cabeleira* (not *cabeça* again after *cabeças*); no remark.

**Ps 67:7b *simíliter eos qui exásperant* → *igualmente os que exasperam*** — absolute, no object supplied (the form 65:7's Latinist asked for); passed the Latinist twice; the ambiguity reader listed *exasperam* unknown and could not tell rescue from punishment, as the Latin. 65:7 and 67:7b now differ — for Gustavo.
Ps 67:30 *tibi ófferent reges múnera* → *os reis vos oferecerão dádivas*; the ambiguity reader listed *dádivas* unknown; kept.
Ps 67:29 *Manda, Deus, virtúti tuæ* → *Dai ordem, Deus, ao vosso poder* (dative); heard rightly.
Ps 67:13 *Rex virtútum dilécti, dilécti* → *O Rei dos poderes é do amado, do amado* (DRB's copula; D43).

terms: | segregáre | reservar (*Reservareis, Deus, para a vossa herança uma chuva voluntária*) | open | Ps 67:10 (ἀφοριεῖς). *separar* is *discérnere*'s (D42; 67:15 five verses later); *Separareis* the option. No remark. |

| cleros (κλῆροι) | partilhas (*Se dormirdes no meio das partilhas*) | open | Ps 67:14 only. *sortes* heard as luck, *lotes* as building plots, *heranças* collides with *heréditas* (67:10). Listed unknown by the ambiguity reader; passed the Latinist twice. |

| ingréssus (πορεῖαι) | passos (*Viram os vossos passos, Deus*) | open | Ps 67:25 (twice), only here. *entradas* (draft 1) heard as tickets / starters by the stylist and the ambiguity reader. Meets *gressus* (16:5 *passos*), its root — accepted. *marchas* option. |

| evangelizáre | evangelizar (*aos que evangelizam*) | open | Ps 67:12. *anunciar a boa-nova* (DRB, MS1932) +7 syllables; the cognate is the Latin's length and the verse's traditional reading. Check 39:10, 95:2 *annuntiáte* vs *bene nuntiáte*. |
| pluvia voluntária | uma chuva voluntária | open | Ps 67:10 (ἑκούσιον); strange as in Latin; *generosa* option. Ambiguity reader: 'freely given', 'sounds odd'. |
| dux | guia (*Os príncipes de Judá, os seus guias*) | open | Ps 67:28b, as 54:14 *dux meus → meu guia* (D44). |

| fit reverentia (rubric in DO's text) | *(faz-se reverência)*, in parentheses | open | Ps 67:5a before *Dóminus nomen illi*; also 110:9b, 112:2 (grep). Kept as a translated rubric; the ambiguity reader noted it would be heard if read aloud. **For the coordinator / Gustavo: keep or drop rubrics?** |
| juvéncula tympanístria | moças que tocavam tamborins | open | Ps 67:26. |
formulas: | *Exsúrgat Deus, et dissipéntur inimíci ejus: et fúgiant qui odérunt eum, a fácie ejus* (67:2; Introit verse of Pentecost (missa Pasc7-0), Pent11-0, 01-19 — grep) | *Levante-se Deus, e sejam dispersos os seus inimigos, * e fujam da sua face os que o odeiam* | open — Ps 67 |

| *Deus in loco sancto suo: Deus qui inhabitáre facit unánimes in domo: ipse dabit virtútem et fortitúdinem plebi suæ* (Introit of Pent11-0, from 67:6b + 67:36 — grep; the Missal reads *unánimes* for *uníus moris*) | *Deus está no seu lugar santo: Deus, que faz habitar numa casa os de um só costume: ele mesmo dará poder e força ao seu povo* | open — Ps 67; the Missal's *unánimes* would need its own word |

| *Confírma hoc, Deus, quod operátus es in nobis: a templo tuo, quod est in Jerúsalem, tibi ófferent reges múnera* (67:29–30; Offertory of Pentecost, and a Pentecost Office antiphon — grep) | *Confirmai, Deus, isto que operastes em nós: * do vosso templo em Jerusalém, os reis vos oferecerão dádivas* | open — Ps 67 |
